# rustfs_policy Resource

Manage S3 policies

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rustfs_policy" "readwrite" {
  name = "readwrite"

  statement = [
    {
      effect = "Allow"
      action = [
        "s3:GetObject",
        "s3:PutObject",
        "s3:DeleteObject",
        "s3:ListBucket",
      ]
      resource = [
        "arn:aws:s3:::my-bucket",
        "arn:aws:s3:::my-bucket/*",
      ]
    },
  ]
}
```
